Takes one artifact and gives `stdout`. Bound to contract `artifact_file_v1` in the `artifact_intake_archive` family, with effect `pure-read` and maturity `defined` at catalog generation `8244d56caf144889e133fe1d98d50c2d6dc575df2290fd505cacc9f2cbf1713d`.

## Run it

From a terminal, or as one node of a mission that leaves a receipt.

```sh Terminal
bonfyre hash file <input-path>
```

```sh Mission
bonfyre fabric artifact ingest <input-path>   # prints uri=bonfyre://artifact/...
bonfyre fabric mission create first
bonfyre fabric work add first step command.hash <uri>
bonfyre fabric work run first                 # prints the output and its receipt
```

## Last verified run

No verified run recorded for this contract generation in this state.

## What is checked

A run is complete only when both checks pass. The result of each is written into the receipt.

- `output-artifact`: the command exited cleanly and left the output its contract names
- `sha256-output`: the printed digest is the SHA-256 of the input that was handed over

## Limits

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| Time | 30 seconds |
| Output | 1048576 bytes |
| Retries | `bounded:0` |

> A run that passes a limit, exits non-zero or fails a check ends as a failed node. Its output is not admitted as an artifact and no later node receives it.

## Options

The command's own usage text.

```text
BonfyreHash — content-addressing engine

Usage:
  bonfyre-hash file <path>                              SHA-256 of file
  bonfyre-hash node <op> <ver> <params_json> <h1,h2>    operator node hash
  bonfyre-hash merkle <artifact.json>                    compute/update root_hash
  bonfyre-hash verify <artifact.json>                    verify all hashes
  bonfyre-hash dedup <dir>                               find duplicate files
  bonfyre-hash feature <features.json>                   stable SAE feature hash URI
```
